title: Inklet
move_pattern: Starts with either Jab or Whirlwind depending on position. Jab leads to a random choice between Piercing Gaze and Whirlwind. Both Whirlwind and Piercing Gaze lead back to Jab.
notes: Piercing Gaze is a hidden move that does not appear in the Bestiary. The monster's starting move depends on whether it is positioned as a middle Inklet.
